clips.title: The story
paras: Deep within Boulderslide Ravine, the shaman Mor'rogal discovers a slumbering Earthen named Goggeroc sealed inside a Resonite cask. Fearing the raw destructive power an ancient being of stone could unleash upon Kalimdor, he sends a champion to shatter the cask and strike Goggeroc down before the creature can recover its full strength.

While investigating the vermin infestation in Boulderslide Ravine, scouts discovered a strange relic nestled among the kobolds: a Resonite cask radiating unearthly force. Mor'rogal, a tauren shaman stationed in the Stonetalon Mountains, recognized the container for what it truly was—a prison and sanctuary housing Goggeroc, a dormant Earthen. These primordial creations of stone possess strength that outmatches mortal warriors, making the prospect of Goggeroc roaming free an existential threat to the region.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have uncovered a dark threat to the land, adventurer. The Resonite cask you have found in that cave houses a slumbering Earthen by the name of Goggeroc.
I have changed the mixture of the Resonite crystals that you gathered with my shamanistic powers. Take the enchanted Resonite crystal and smash open the Resonite cask, which houses the Earthen.
When awakened, Goggeroc will be weakened... Slay him, friend!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I fear if we do not dispose of this threat immediately, all of Stonetalon will be lost. The might of an Earthen can not be matched by any means. When awakened, Goggeroc will be weak from his long slumber, this will be the opportunity that you must take advantage of... Go now friend!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You bear good news, adventurer! I fear the possibilities of what an Earthen would mean to Kalimdor.
Slaying Goggeroc was a task for no one less then a hero. You have done well; all of Stonetalon and Kalimdor are indebted to you, noble adventurer.
Accept this as your reward most honored one.
